name: product-research-toolkit
description: OpenCode product-research skill with local Yandex and Avito analytics MCP servers

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix mcp/avito-analytics && npm ci --prefix mcp/yandex-analytics && npm ci --prefix mcp/market-research-sqlite
scripts.check: node scripts/validate-product-research.mjs && npm run check --prefix mcp/avito-analytics && npm run check --prefix mcp/yandex-analytics && npm run check --prefix mcp/market-research-sqlite
scripts.test: npm run check && npm test --prefix mcp/market-research-sqlite
